description: Standalone StreamSets Data Collector (SDC) engine pipelines as Dagster assets -- no Control Hub involved. One asset per declared pipeline; action=start starts the pipeline on materialize and polls status until RUNNING. Optional shared polling sensor emits AssetObservation when a pipeline's status changes. Optional pipeline_running asset_check. Optional expose_metrics attaches the engine's real metrics endpoint as asset metadata. demo_mode runs the whole shape with synthetic data and zero real engine instance.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per declared standalone SDC pipeline. With action=noop (default) each asset is declare-only (external asset). With action=start each materialization starts the pipeline via the engine's REST API and polls status to confirm it reached RUNNING; action=stop stops it and polls until STOPPED. Optional polling_sensor emits AssetObservation per pipeline when its status changes; optional require_running check per pipeline; optional expose_metrics attaches the real metrics endpoint's output.

base_url_env_var.label: Engine URL Env Var
base_url_env_var.description: Env var holding the SDC engine's base URL, e.g. http://localhost:18630 (no Control Hub involved).

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var with the engine login username (HTTP Basic -- confirmed live against this engine's own OpenAPI spec).

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var with the engine login password.

pipelines.label: Pipelines
pipelines.description: SDC pipelines to wrap as Dagster assets, one entry per pipeline (pipeline_id, asset_key, description, group_name, deps, owners, tags). Find pipeline_id via the engine's Pipelines UI or GET /rest/v1/pipelines -- a real, working discovery endpoint on this engine, unlike Control Hub's Job Runner API.

assets_by_pipeline.label: Assets By Pipeline
assets_by_pipeline.description: Override the asset spec for specific pipelines, keyed by pipeline_id. Mirrors StreamSetsWorkspaceComponent's assets_by_job shape.

action.label: Action
action.description: noop = external asset (declare-only); start = start the pipeline and poll status until RUNNING (raises if it instead lands on a *_ERROR/KILLED status); stop = stop the pipeline (or forceStop if force_stop=true) and poll until STOPPED.

force_stop.label: Force Stop
force_stop.description: When action=stop, use forceStop instead of a graceful stop. Ignored for action=start/noop.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the target status before failing the run. Only used when action=start/stop.

polling_sensor.label: Polling Sensor
polling_sensor.description: If true, adds ONE sensor (not one per pipeline) that emits AssetObservation per pipeline when its status changed since the last tick.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval (seconds)
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between sensor polls. Only used when polling_sensor=True.

require_running.label: Require Running
require_running.description: If true, attach a pipeline_running asset_check per pipeline that fails when the pipeline's current status isn't RUNNING.

expose_metrics.label: Expose Metrics
expose_metrics.description: If true, action=start fetches the real /rest/v1/pipeline/{id}/metrics endpoint after reaching RUNNING and attaches the raw Dropwizard metrics registry as asset metadata -- a confirmed-live capability Control Hub's sibling component lacks.

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for pipelines without their own group_name.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Catalog tags applied to every pipeline asset (merged with each pipeline's own tags).

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Default asset owners for pipelines without their own.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Skip the real engine connection entirely. Start/stop and status all return synthetic values instead of calling the REST API.

name: StreamSets Engine
